title: stelechantha cauliflora
intro: Stelechantha cauliflora, commonly known as "Strychnos nux-vomica", is a plant species belonging to the Loganiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antimalarial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stelechanta cauliflora include pain relief, fever reduction, and treatment of various infections. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, particularly strychnine and brucine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
